metadata.dataset_name: Data Centre Warm Channel Temperature prediction
metadata.target_variable: TLHC (Standardized Left Hot Corridor Exhaust Air)
metadata.standardization: z-score (mean=0, std=1, original physical scale factors unavailable)

simulator_baseline_parameters.units: Celsius per 1-minute step with normalized [0, 1] workload and cooling

rejection_reasons: Cooling coefficient b=-0.03762 is non-positive (cooling increases temperature, indicating closed-loop feedback confounding)
Telemetry is dimensionless z-score standardized without physical scale factors (mean/std).
Sampling interval is 15 minutes (900s), whereas simulator operates on 1-minute steps.
Telemetry represents single-zone hot corridor, containing no 5-zone spatial coupling or workload migration.
validation_decision.action_taken: Retain existing validated simulator physics. Do not overwrite config/topology.json.
